body:
Source: GitHub issue #689 (bug, false-green, P1-high, area:review). Re-verified on main @ 91d2fba0: packages/model-ratchet/bin/model-ratchet.mjs:105-125. `isGitRepo(cwd)` succeeds from any subdirectory inside a git repository. However, `churn(churnLimit, cwd)` returns paths relative to the git repository root, while `walkSourceFiles(cwd)` returns paths relative to `cwd`. When run from a subdirectory, the two key-spaces never match: every file's churn score is 0, every file's total score is 0, the ranking falls back to arbitrary alphabetical order, and findings are appended to `<cwd>/.adlc/findings.jsonl` instead of the repository root's ledger.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/model-ratchet`: `bin/model-ratchet.mjs` (CLI entry point), `lib/walk.mjs` (walkSourceFiles, computeInDegree), `lib/scoring.mjs`, `lib/graph.mjs`, `lib/format.mjs`, `lib/run-review.mjs`. Tests: `npm test -w packages/model-ratchet` from the worktree root. Note: `@adlc/core` already exports `repoRoot(cwd)` which executes `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/model-ratchet/bin/model-ratchet.mjs`: import `repoRoot` from `@adlc/core`. After verifying `isGitRepo(cwd)`, resolve `const root = repoRoot(cwd);`.
2. In `packages/model-ratchet/bin/model-ratchet.mjs`: pass `root` (instead of `cwd`) to `churn(churnLimit, root)`, `walkSourceFiles(root)`, and `computeInDegree(sourceFiles, root)`. Also ensure the findings ledger path resolves relative to `root` (`join(root, '.adlc', 'findings.jsonl')`).
3. When run from any subdirectory of a git repository, candidate files and churn files share the same repo-relative key-space and receive non-zero churn scores.
4. Documentation: update `packages/model-ratchet/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `docs/tools/model-ratchet.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/model-ratchet.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Running model-ratchet from a repository subdirectory calculates non-zero churn for hot files matching repo root. verify: `node --test packages/model-ratchet/test/subdirectory-root.test.mjs`
- AC2 Running model-ratchet from a repository subdirectory targets `<root>/.adlc/findings.jsonl`. verify: `node --test packages/model-ratchet/test/subdirectory-root.test.mjs`
- AC3 Existing test suite passes with no regressions. verify: `npm test -w packages/model-ratchet`
- AC4 Docs updated in all three mirror files. verify: `grep -c "repository root" packages/model-ratchet/README.md docs/tools/model-ratchet.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/model-ratchet.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC5 Mutation gate green on branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`

OUT OF SCOPE: Issue #688 (empty selection exit 2) or #690 (Windows backslash separator normalization).
title: model-ratchet: resolve git repository root for walk, churn, and findings ledger
